abilities.name: Forceful Fists of Frost

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description:
Coalescing frost about his fist, Wriothesley will unleash powerful Repelling Fists, performing up to 5 rapid attacks that deal Cryo DMG.
Apart from this, Normal Attack combo count will not reset for a short time after using Icefang Rush or sprinting.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description: Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina to leap and unleash a Vaulting Fist, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Cryo DMG upon impact.

abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Coalescing frost about his fist, Wriothesley will unleash powerful Repelling Fists, performing up to 5 rapid attacks that deal Cryo DMG.
Apart from this, Normal Attack combo count will not reset for a short time after using Icefang Rush or sprinting.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina to leap and unleash a Vaulting Fist, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Cryo DMG upon impact.
_curatorNotes: 5-press combo with 6 total damage instances (N4 has two hitmarks at frames 25 and 35; per recipe, the last hitmark — 35 — is the cancel-frame source).
N5 cancel-into-charge is real (gcsim explicitly sets ActionCharge=39 on attackFrames[4], same as the hitmark). C key included on N5 even though final-hit convention usually omits it.
Catalyst CA is gated by gcsim's NextQueueItemIsValid: charge cannot be queued unless prior action is ActionAttack — this is a per-character constraint not modeled in the planner.
High plunge variants exist in gcsim but are not represented per recipe; lowPlungeFrames used for plungeFrames. lowPlungeFrames[ActionJump] not set in gcsim — J omitted.

Combo-counter persistence: gcsim preserves NormalCounter across DashState and SkillState (savedNormalCounter mechanic), enabling N continues after dash/E. Description-level mechanic; planner may not model this.

abilities.name: Forceful Fists of Frost (Chilling Penalty)
abilities.description: Wriothesley's normal-attack combo while in the Chilling Penalty state from Icefang Rush. The 5-press combo and frame timings are identical to the base normal — gcsim uses the same attackFrames slice — but each hit's damage is multiplied by an additional skill-talent coefficient and consumes a fixed portion of Wriothesley's HP. No element conversion (already Cryo).
_curatorNotes: Frames are IDENTICAL to base normal; gcsim does not maintain a separate ppAttackFrames-style slice (Hu Tao precedent does not apply here). The split is authored to surface the in-stance state to the planner, not to encode different timing.
In-stance damage: gcsim multiplies normal-attack Mult by skill[talent] in the Snapshot path. skill[8] (TL9 baseline) = 1.669515 — i.e. ~67% multiplier on top of base normals while gated active.
Gating: skillBuffActive() requires StatusIsActive(skillKey) AND CurrentHPRatio() > 0.5. The schema's `state: "inStance"` only models the status flag, NOT the >50% HP gate. Reviewer to extend or flag.

HP-cost mechanic: each in-stance N hit triggers chillingPenalty callback that drains 4.5% of MaxHP with a 6f ICD (gcsim skillLoseHPICD). Not authored as an effect; HP economy is not modeled in the planner.
Hitboxes are slightly enlarged in-stance (attackHitboxes[1] vs [0]) — cosmetic / out-of-scope.
Particle generation: each in-stance hit fires particleCB (1 cryo particle, 2s ICD). Out of scope for first-pass authoring; reviewer to add particle model.

abilities.name: Icefang Rush
abilities.description:
Adjusting his breathing, rhythm, and pace, Wriothesley sprints forward a short distance, entering the Chilling Penalty state and unleashing more powerful attacks than before.

Chilling Penalty
·Increases Wriothesley's interruption resistance
·When his HP is above 50%, it will enhance the Repelling Fists of Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost and increase its DMG. When such an attack hits, it will consume a fixed amount of Wriothesley's HP. HP can be lost this way once every 0.1s.
This effect will be canceled should Wriothesley leave the field.
_curatorNotes: ↻ THE INHERITED `atk% 50 / trigger: manual` EFFECT IS DELETED, 2026-09-16 (T0.5). The note here had asked for exactly that since 2026-05-14 ("Likely a generator artifact. Reviewer to delete or correct; do not author replacement") and it was never done. It has no source in the game text or in gcsim — no AddStatMod for ATKP comes from Icefang Rush. It drew no planner bar, because a `manual` trigger reaches no planner surface, but deriveCapabilities never inspected triggers, so the index shipped {buff, atk%, self, minCon 0} and the Team Builder told every reader that this skill grants +50% ATK. The TB now skips `manual` too (2026-09-15), so this deletion is belt and braces — and the value was fabricated either way. ⛔ No replacement authored.
Stance ends on swap: gcsim's onExit() subscribes to OnCharacterSwap and calls DeleteStatus(skillKey) when prev == self. terminatesOnSwap: true confirmed by source.
Stance duration source: `c.AddStatus(skillKey, 10*60+skillCDDelay, true)` → 10s + 1f ≈ 10s.

Skill enhancement of N is gated by HP > 50% (skillBuffActive). The stance flag persists through HP changes, but the damage enhancement only applies while above 50%. Schema's `inStance` condition cannot express this; flagged on the in-stance N variant as well.

C1 extends the stance by 4s when a Rebuke: Vaulting Fist hits while in-stance (gcsim ExtendStatus). One extension per stance window. Fits the `durationExtensions[]` primitive (E5, 2026-05-10) on the skill stance: `{ trigger: { type: 'onHit', filter: { abilityName: 'Rebuke: Vaulting Fist' } }, delta: 4, maxExtensions: 1 }`. Authoring blocked on parser dispatching `onHit` events to stance owners — currently only `onCast` extensions fire.

Energy particle generation comes from the in-stance NORMAL hits, not from the skill cast itself (gcsim particleCB is wired into chillingPenalty path). Approx 1 cryo particle per stance hit with 2s ICD.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim wriothesley/skill.go:31-54: status only.

abilities.name: Darkgold Wolfbite
abilities.description:
Activating his boxing gloves, Wriothesley strikes out with an icy straight, then uses Icicle Impact to cause multiple instances of AoE Cryo DMG in a frontal area.

Arkhe: Ousia
After Icicle Impact ends, a Surging Blade will descend upon the opponent's position, dealing Ousia-aligned Cryo DMG.
_curatorNotes: burstFrames only sets ActionSwap=94 explicitly; all other actions fall back to InitAbilSlice's 133 (AnimationLength). Per recipe, only swap is recorded — N/E/D/J would be silent AnimationLength defaults.

Icicle Impact fires 5 hits at burstHitmarks {99, 104, 109, 114, 119}. Surging Blade (Ousia follow-up) lands at frame 160 with a 10s ICD between Surging Blade procs (gcsim burstOusiaICDKey). Removed the 'Surging Blade' burst variant 2026-07-15: it modeled the Arkhe follow-up's 10s ICD as a variant cooldown, but Surging Blade is an internal component of the burst cast, not a token-selectable Q variant — no notation selects it, so it was unreachable dead data. Its DMG remains frame-represented within the burst.
Q snapshots ATK at cast (gcsim Snapshot called once, then QueueAttackWithSnap for all 5 hits + Surging Blade). Reviewer to confirm snapshot semantics for the planner's buff timing.
C2 adds 40% × a4Stack to Q DMG (snap.Stats[DmgP] += 0.4 * a4Stack at cast). Not authored — depends on a4Stack runtime which schema cannot express.

passives.name: There Shall Be a Plea for Justice
passives.description:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60%, he will obtain a Gracious Rebuke. The next Charged Attack of his Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost will be enhanced to become Rebuke: Vaulting Fist. It will not consume Stamina, will deal 50% increased DMG, and after hitting will restore HP for Wriothesley equal to 30% of his Max HP.
You can gain a Gracious Rebuke this way once every 5s.
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: rewrote from `damage hp 30 target:enemy` to `heal self hp 30`. The 30% MaxHP is the HEAL granted to Wriothesley on Rebuke: Vaulting Fist hit, not a damage instance.

2026-05-11 (E2 follow-up): trigger migrated from `manual` to `onHit charged-attack` + `selfHpBelow: 60` condition + `procCooldown: 5`. Schema simplification — fires on any charged-attack hit with the HP gate, not specifically on the 5th-Repelling-Fists-into-Rebuke chain (would need a stack-counter for Repelling Fists hits). Acceptable approximation — the 5s ICD bounds proc rate.

The +50% DMG component of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist (gcsim asc.go: snap.Stats[DmgP] += 0.5) is not authored. It applies as a snapshot-time DMG bonus on the consuming charged attack. Likely shape: type:'buff', target:'self', stat:'allDmgBonus' (or chargedDmgBonus), trigger:onCast charged-attack, conditions: hpBelow60 + 5s procCooldown. Reviewer to model.
Stamina-cost waiver on Rebuke (gcsim ActionStam returns 0 when graciousRebukeReady) — stamina is not modeled in the planner. No effect to author.

↻ The heal is a mutually-exclusive C4 PAIR since 2026-09-16 (T0.5): 30% below C4, 50% at C4. gcsim keeps one variable, c.caHeal, set to 0.3 or 0.5 by cons.go's c4() — the C4 entry used to author a SECOND heal effect of its own, which derived as a second heal capability in the Team Builder for a kit that heals once. ⚠️ The same pair is on the Witch's Revelation rewrite below, and they must stay in step for the same reason: one variable, two code paths.

passives.name: There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin
passives.description: When Wriothesley's current HP increases or decreases, if he is in the Chilling Penalty state conferred by Icefang Rush, Chilling Penalty will gain one stack of Prosecution Edict. Max 5 stacks. Each stack will increase Wriothesley's ATK by 6%.
_curatorNotes: Intentionally not authored per stub-with-caveat philosophy 2026-05-14 (onPlayerHit + onHeal categories — both HP-change subscriptions are null-resolving in the planner; HP state isn't simulated). Probable shape if a primitive ever lands: type:'buff', target:'self', stat:'atk%', value: scaling on stack count (6% × stacks, max 5 stacks = 30%), trigger gated on stance + HP-change subscription. gcsim source: subscribes to OnPlayerHPDrain and OnHeal; stacks reset when stance ends (resetA4 called on each Skill cast).
Stance ATK% buff is applied via applyA4 when E is cast and recomputed dynamically each frame — modifier.NewBaseWithHitlag for a 10s+1f duration matching stance lifetime.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The received-buff lane under Wriothesley during his 10s Chilling Penalty stance bar. A player who knows him expects an ATK% bar riding that stance and finds the lane empty — the passive authors no effect at all, and its real trigger (onHit/onHeal HP change) is rubric N6, unconsumed. A 10s, stance-wide, up-to-30% ATK buff is exactly the shape the buff lane exists to draw, so its blank is a real confusion. Category: expected-but-absent.

↻ AUTHORED 2026-09-16 (T0.5), filling the blank the 2026-08-19 note named: the received-buff lane under the 10s Chilling Penalty bar was empty, which is exactly the shape that lane exists to draw. gcsim skill.go:41-45 calls resetA4() then applyA4(10*60 + skillCDDelay) at the cast, so the window IS the stance and `onCast skill` + duration 10 is its true span. Only the VALUE is a stand-in: the mod's amount is dynamic (a4Stack * 0.06) and stacks come from HP changes, which the planner does not simulate. 30% is the stacked-at-max convention already used for Cyno's C2 and Noelle/Mona C6, and the caveat names the optimism.

⛔ Not authorable as a ramp: the stack triggers are OnPlayerHPDrain and OnHeal (asc.go:80-117), an HP-change subscription with no primitive here — rubric N6, unconsumed. ⚓ The same gap still blocks C2's +40%-per-stack burst bonus, which reads this pool.
passives.caveat: Shown at the full 5 stacks for the whole window; in game the stacks build one per HP change, so the first few seconds are lower.

passives.name: There Shall Be an Unveiling for Injustice
passives.description:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" is changed to the following:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60%, he will obtain a "Gracious Rebuke: Unveiling." This enhances the next Charged Attack of his Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost into Luster: Vaulting Fist, which will not consume Stamina and restores 30% Max HP to Wriothesley upon hit. Wriothesley can gain HP in this way once every 2s.
Additionally, the third and fifth strikes of Repelling Fist enhanced by Chilling Penalty will deal 60% and 80% of their original Cryo DMG respectively, while Luster: Vaulting Fist will deal 100% of its original AoE Cryo DMG. The aforementioned DMG is considered as Stellar-Conduct DMG, and Wriothesley deals 30% increased Stellar-Conduct DMG.
Additionally, when inside a Polestar Field, Wriothesley will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.
_curatorNotes: Stellar-Conduct round 2026-07-29. New current-patch talent: the Witch's Revelation Passive (Fandom page 'There Shall Be an Unveiling for Injustice', Change History 'Luna VIII'; utility tags Healing / Base DMG Multiplier / Direct Stellar-Conduct / Stellar-Conduct DMG Bonus). Evidence is wiki-only — gcsim has no Stellar implementation.

Gate: the whole talent body is the 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct' state, which the wiki says is entered 'when inside a Polestar Field'. Authored as `teamEnablesReaction: stellarConduct` (Sandrone is the only enabler this patch); the narrower in-field requirement is stated in the caveat, since we have no field-presence primitive.

Authored: +30% Stellar-Conduct DMG, self, always-on under the gate. RE-KEYED 2026-07-29 to `stellarConductReactionBonus` (bucket 5 — the wiki files the talent under 'Stellar-Conduct DMG Bonus', the Reaction Bonus category; Nate's ruling gave bucket 5 its own stat family, so the earlier bucket-3 `stellarConductDmgBonus` keying is superseded). Wiki wording 'Wriothesley deals 30% increased Stellar-Conduct DMG' is character-wide, not instance-scoped.

Authored: the Luster: Vaulting Fist heal — 30% Max HP on a charged-attack hit, HP gain once every 2s (base A1 is once every 5s). Value is unchanged from A1, so under the gate this REPLACES A1's heal rather than adding to it; both render, same as the existing C4 50% duplicate. Trigger/condition shape copied from the A1 heal (onHit charged + selfHpBelow 60).

NOT authored (damage magnitude, per the tool constitution): the 3rd and 5th Chilling-Penalty Repelling Fists dealing 60%/80% and Luster: Vaulting Fist dealing 100% of their original Cryo DMG as Stellar-Conduct DMG. Wiki wording is ambiguous between converting those hits and adding a separate Stellar-Conduct instance; either reading is DMG output, not a stat.

NOT authored: Polestar Field internals and the Base Reaction Coefficient hit ledger (1 → 1.45 + 0.05 per recorded Cryo/Electro hit, max 12), per docs/library/game/stellar-reactions.md — unmodelable by Nate's call. Note the wiki's own table starts at 1.45 for 1 hit, which resolves the NEEDS-CONFIRM in that doc's step reading.

game8 cross-check: its 'CA restores 30% Max HP, cooldown 2s' matches the wiki, and the direction is indeed a heal (the base kit's HP *cost* is on in-stance Normal hits, not on the Charged Attack). Its 60%/80%/100% conversions and +30% Stellar-Conduct DMG also match. No numeric disagreement found.

Base kit unchanged this patch: A1, A4, Icefang Rush (CD 16s / 10s duration) and Darkgold Wolfbite (CD 15s / 60 energy) wiki pages still carry the 4.1 text and values — no permanent patch to apply, no CD change.

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "Shown as always on; in game these enhancements need a Stellar-Conduct enabler in the party and require standing inside the Polestar Field. Not modeled: the 3rd and 5th Repelling Fists and the enhanced Charged Attack dealing part of their DMG as Stellar-Conduct DMG."

↻ The Luster: Vaulting Fist heal is a mutually-exclusive C4 pair too, 2026-09-16 (T0.5) — 30% below C4, 50% at C4, matching the base A1's. gcsim's c.caHeal is ONE variable and cons.go's c4() sets it for both paths, so the Radiance form gets the C4 upgrade as well. ⛔ The pre-existing double render — this heal AND the base A1's both drawing under a Stellar-Conduct enabler, where in game this one REPLACES it — is deliberately untouched: gating the base on `not teamEnablesReaction` would delete it for anyone who merely SLOTS an enabler, and the Radiance form additionally needs the player to be standing in the Polestar Field, which this passive's caveat already states and which we cannot model.
passives.caveat: Shown as always on; in game these enhancements need a Stellar-Conduct enabler in the party and require standing inside the Polestar Field.

constellations.name: Terror for the Evildoers
constellations.description:
The Gracious Rebuke from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" is changed to this:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60% or while he is in the Chilling Penalty state caused by Icefang Rush, when the fifth attack of Repelling Fists hits, it will create a Gracious Rebuke. 1 Gracious Rebuke effect can be obtained every 2.5s.

Additionally, Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will obtain the following enhancement:
· The DMG Bonus gained will be further increased to 200%.
· When it hits while Wriothesley is in the Chilling Penalty state, that state's duration is extended by 4s. 1 such extension can occur per 1 Chilling Penalty duration.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
_curatorNotes: Inherited skeleton has trigger:'manual' with stat:'allDmgBonus' value:200. The 200% is the C1-upgraded snapshot DMG bonus on Rebuke: Vaulting Fist (replaces A1's 50%). Probable shape: trigger onCast charged-attack, conditions hpBelow60 OR inStance, 2.5s procCooldown, snapshot-style. Reviewer to model.
Stance-extension component (Rebuke hit while in-stance extends duration by 4s, once per stance) is not authored. Schema has no per-stance-window proc-cap field. Reviewer to extend.
C1 also adds a second Gracious Rebuke trigger: N5 hit during stance also generates one. Stack-source diversification not modeled.

Stellar-Conduct round 2026-07-29 (wiki-only evidence): the Witch's Revelation rewrite of this constellation (Fandom Constellation Infobox `buff` field) keeps the base text and appends a 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct' block — (a) after Luster: Vaulting Fist hits, the next Chilling-Penalty 5th Repelling Fist to hit within 5s deals 50% increased Stellar-Conduct DMG; (b) after that 5th Repelling Fist hits, Luster: Vaulting Fists hitting within 5s deal 50% increased DMG; (c) the 4s Chilling Penalty extension keys off Luster: Vaulting Fist instead of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist, still once per stance.

Not authored: (a) and (b) are single-instance-scoped DMG bonuses inside an alternating 5s ping-pong — a self stellarConductDmgBonus/allDmgBonus window would apply far more broadly than the game does. (c) is the same stance extension already blocked on onHit dispatch to stance owners. The pre-Revelation base text is unchanged this patch, so the existing (separately queued) allDmgBonus 200 effect is untouched.

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "Not modeled: the enhanced Charged Attack extending Chilling Penalty by 4s, once per window — or, with a Stellar-Conduct enabler in the party, it and the fifth Repelling Fist each giving the other +50% DMG for 5s."

↻ THE `allDmgBonus 200 / manual` EFFECT IS RETIRED TO THE DESCRIPTION, 2026-09-16 (T0.5; manual-trigger-retirement step 3, retire). It is not a buff window at all: gcsim cons.go:32-55 adds it to the SNAPSHOT of a single Rebuke: Vaulting Fist attack (snap.Stats[DmgP] += 2.0), one hit, consumed immediately. Authored as a duration-less self buff it derived as an unconditional +200% all-DMG capability in the Team Builder, and data-outliers.md flagged the magnitude. A single hit's damage multiplier is out of scope by the tool constitution; the constellation's own text keeps the claim.
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the enhanced Charged Attack extending Chilling Penalty by 4s once per window, so the skill's active span is shown 4s short.

constellations.name: Shackles for the Arrogant
constellations.description:
When using Darkgold Wolfbite, each Prosecution Edict stack from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin" will increase said ability's DMG dealt by 40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin."
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. gcsim cons.go c2: snap.Stats[DmgP] += 0.4 * a4Stack at burst-cast time. Probable shape: type:'buff', target:'self', stat:'allDmgBonus' (or burstDmgBonus), value scaling on a4 stack count (40% × stacks, max 5 = 200%), trigger onCast burst, conditions: requires inStance at cast time + a4 stack count > 0. Schema has no stack-count condition.

Stellar-Conduct round 2026-07-29 (wiki-only evidence): the Witch's Revelation rewrite (Fandom Constellation Infobox `buff` field) keeps the 40%-per-stack burst bonus and adds a branch that fires at 5 Prosecution Edict stacks — in the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state the Chilling-Penalty 3rd/5th Repelling Fists go to 90%/120% and Luster: Vaulting Fist to 150% of their original Cryo DMG as Stellar-Conduct DMG; outside that state Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks deal 125%/130% of their original DMG.

Not authored: both branches are damage magnitudes, and both hang off the Prosecution Edict stack count, which is untracked (A4 stacks are already flagged unmodeled). The non-Stellar 125%/130% branch is a PERMANENT patch (no enabler needed) but is equally unmodelable — a stack-gated instance multiplier, not a stat buff. No enabler-negated condition authored: the real gate is the Radiance state, not merely the absence of an enabler.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Every clause is a damage multiplier on an attack instance — 125%/130% of DMG, or a stronger Stellar-Conduct hit. The planner draws no damage anywhere (tool constitution, FROZEN section), so nothing on screen is wrong, short, or missing. The gating stack count is itself invisible (no stack counter exists on any surface), so there is not even a blank the player could notice. Category: invisible-omission.

constellations.name: Redemption for the Suffering
constellations.description:
The HP restored to Wriothesley through Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased to 50% of his Max HP. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
Additionally, when Wriothesley is healed, if the amount of healing overflows, the following effects will occur depending on whether he is on the field or not. If he is on the field, his ATK SPD will be increased by 20% for 4s. If he is off-field, all of your own party members' ATK SPD will be increased by 10% for 6s. These two methods of increasing ATK SPD cannot stack.
_curatorNotes: Inherited heal skeleton (50% MaxHP) corresponds to the C4 upgrade of A1's Rebuke heal — replaces the 30% in the base passive. Probable trigger: onHit charged-attack (Rebuke), conditions hpBelow60 OR inStance with 2.5s/5s ICD depending on C1. Reviewer to wire.

The ATK SPD overheal mechanic is not authored. Two branches: on-field self +20% ATK SPD for 4s, off-field team +10% for 6s. Trigger event is OnHeal with overheal>0 condition — schema has no overheal trigger. Reviewer to extend or flag.

Stellar-Conduct round 2026-07-29 (wiki-only evidence): the Witch's Revelation rewrite (Fandom Constellation Infobox `buff` field) replaces the whole overheal ATK SPD mechanic while in the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state with an unconditional package — 25% less DMG taken, +20% ATK SPD for himself, +10% ATK SPD for other nearby party members. The 50% Max HP Rebuke heal is unchanged.

Not authored: there is no `atkSpd` Stat key and no damage-reduction Effect or Stat in the union (checked 2026-07-29), so neither half is expressible. This is the only team-facing piece of the Stellar layer on this character — worth revisiting if either primitive lands.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — There is no `atkSpd` Stat key and no damage-reduction Effect or Stat in the union (the curator note confirms both, checked 2026-07-29), so ATK SPD and DMG reduction are categories the tool never depicts for ANY character — like damage numbers. The trigger is overheal, which has no schema shape either. No bar is short, none is missing from a place the tool otherwise fills. Category: invisible-omission.
